description: The chart illustrates the comparative performance of three models, RedWhale, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the performance values, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2, although the axis label is not visible. Each category contains a grouped bar for the three models, with RedWhale represented by dark blue, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 by light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) by grey; the bars for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) consistently reach the maximum value of 1.0 across all categories, while the other two models have varying heights, with RedWhale ranging from approximately 0.42 to 0.70 and EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 ranging from approximately 0.46 to 0.74. The bars are grouped by category, with no stacking, and the categories are not sorted in any particular order. The chart does not display any visual emphasis on specific bars, but the values are annotated above each bar.
